recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If the unused minified jQuery UI stylesheet is ever reviewed, handle it only as generated/vendor cleanup if a current template starts loading it; it is not a current FHIR-3680 defect.
issue_request: FHIR-3680 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 correction reporting that resource names on resourcelist.html and in tree views were not visibly highlighted as hyperlinks, with a side note that footer links were hard to read.
initial_application: Git commit 6f8a0bc1ad22cdccdfac145a45579881f5227762, titled '{#3680} - fix link colours' and carrying git-svn build@3271, matches the Jira comments saying 'fixed svn revision 3271'. It removed the jQuery UI .ui-widget-content a color override from tools/html/jquery-ui.css and added explicit light colors to footer links.
additional_context: The current resource index remains a source page with resource-name anchors and current templates load jquery-ui.css, whose unminified build copy still omits the removed .ui-widget-content a override. Current footer templates preserve explicit light link colors against the red footer background. The hierarchy/tree CSS does not add a link-color override. FTS-safe Zulip and Confluence searches found no later conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already embodies the requested UI correction, and editing current templates or vendor CSS would be optional styling churn rather than a required specification fix.
